CREATE PROCEDURE gold.sp_InsertNewGoldHours_Incremental
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @FromHour DATETIME2;
    DECLARE @CurrentHour DATETIME2;

    -- Last hour already present in Gold (if empty, start from very old date)
    SELECT @FromHour = MAX("Hour Started At")
    FROM gold.crypto_candles_reporting;

    SET @FromHour = ISNULL(@FromHour, CAST('1900-01-01T00:00:00' AS DATETIME2));

    -- Do not load the current hour (still in progress)
    SET @CurrentHour = DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, SYSUTCDATETIME()), 0);

    INSERT INTO gold.crypto_candles_reporting
    (
        "Trading Pair",
        "Hour Started At",
        "Trade Date On",
        "Open Price",
        "High Price",
        "Low Price",
        "Close Price",
        "Volume"
    )
    SELECT
        trading_pair,
        hour_ts,
        trade_date,
        MAX(open_price)  AS open_price,
        MAX(high_price)  AS high_price,
        MIN(low_price)   AS low_price,
        MAX(close_price) AS close_price,
        SUM(volume)      AS volume
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            trading_pair,
            DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, open_timestamp), 0) AS hour_ts,
            CAST(open_timestamp AS DATE) AS trade_date,

            FIRST_VALUE(open_price) OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY trading_pair,
                             DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, open_timestamp), 0)
                ORDER BY open_timestamp ASC
            ) AS open_price,

            FIRST_VALUE(close_price) OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY trading_pair,
                             DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, open_timestamp), 0)
                ORDER BY open_timestamp DESC
            ) AS close_price,

            high_price,
            low_price,
            volume
        FROM silver.crypto_candles
        WHERE open_timestamp >= @FromHour      -- only new minutes since last loaded hour
          AND open_timestamp <  @CurrentHour   -- only completed hours
    ) t
    GROUP BY
        trading_pair,
        hour_ts,
        trade_date
    HAVING NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM gold.crypto_candles_reporting g
        WHERE g."Trading Pair"    = trading_pair
          AND g."Hour Started At" = hour_ts
          AND g."Trade Date On"   = trade_date
    );
END;
GO
